title: How to Respond to LinkedIn Recruiters
description:
If a recruiter DMs you on LinkedIn () here’s how to respond if you ARE interested in the role and the company, and would like to find out more information! Communications Templates are a super easy, stress-free way to handle so much of the job searching dialogue. Not sure where to look? You can find them in your Job Tracker on the right side of the page!  #linkedin #linkedintips #emailtips #communicationtips #jobsearch #recruiterjobs
